## Findings
- [ ] **[Coverage/REGRESSION] domkit addition dropped overall coverage 85.8 → 84.2**
  - **Status quo:** Overall coverage fell 1.6 pts versus the 2026-08-03 baseline (85.8% at 8bef332). The drop is caused by the new `domkit` package (#90) at 74.1% — 65 zero-hit blocks across `schema.go`, `markdown.go`, `images.go`, `truncate.go` — including the selector/filter engine and error paths.
  - **Likely cause:** The X-3 extraction shipped with conformance/boundary tests but no unit coverage of selector internals, JSON-LD extraction, image stripping, and truncation branches.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add unit tests for: `matchesSelector`/`matchesSimpleSelector`/`matchesAttributeSelector` (class/id/attr/combination cases), `schemaTypeFromHTML` (ld+json hit, malformed JSON, `type` fallback), `selectSource` error paths (parse failure, unmatched selector), `renderImage`/`StripBase64Images` (alt fallback, empty alt), `Truncate` boundaries.
  - **Uncovered:** `domkit/schema.go:87-89` (Render error path, in `Render`), `domkit/schema.go:127-145` (parse/selector errors, in `selectSource`), `domkit/schema.go:195-233` (selector matching, in `matchesSelector`/`matchesAttributeSelector`), `domkit/schema.go:249-288` (JSON-LD, in `schemaTypeFromHTML`), `domkit/markdown.go:39-41` (parse error, in `Markdown`), `domkit/markdown.go:210-220` (image rendering, in `renderImage`), `domkit/images.go:23-51` (in `StripBase64Images`), `domkit/truncate.go:29-70` (in `Truncate`)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Medium effort / medium impact

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] fsutil error paths untested (62.9%)**
  - **Status quo:** The symlink-hardened write/remove/mkdir helpers — security-sensitive code — have no tests for their failure branches: `SafeWriteFile` open/fstat/non-regular-file/short-write paths, `SafeRemove` open/fstat/close paths, `SafeMkdirAll` symlink-rejection (non-root) and ENOTDIR paths, and `writeTempThenRename` (atomicwrite.go).
  - **Likely cause:** Tests cover the happy paths only; error branches require syscall-error injection.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add tests using read-only dirs / FIFOs / dangling symlinks to force each error branch (open on read-only dir, ENOTDIR on regular-file component, symlink in path for `SafeMkdirAll`).
  - **Uncovered:** `fsutil/safewrite.go:19-49` (in `SafeWriteFile`), `fsutil/safewrite.go:52-79` (in `SafeRemove`), `fsutil/safewrite.go:88-134` (in `SafeMkdirAll`), `fsutil/atomicwrite.go:14-40` (in `writeTempThenRename`)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact

- [ ] **[Coverage/WARN] sqlitekit Open/Migrate error branches untested (70.8%)**
  - **Status quo:** `sqlitekit.Open` failure branches (mkdir failure, DSN/ping failure) and every `Migrate` failure branch (schema_migrations create, migrations dir read, version query, migration read, begin, exec, insert, commit) are uncovered — 11 zero-hit blocks in `sqlitekit.go`.
  - **Likely cause:** Tests exercise the happy path and migration idempotency but not error injection.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add tests: `Open` with an uncreatable dir and an invalid path; `Migrate` with a failing fs.FS (unreadable migrations dir, malformed SQL, transaction rollback on exec error).
  - **Uncovered:** `sqlitekit/sqlitekit.go:28-42` (in `Open`), `sqlitekit/sqlitekit.go:68-118` (in `Migrate`)
  - **Effort/Impact:** Low effort / medium impact
